# Sources

This folder contains the provenance records for the three annual reports of the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Diseases (DANIBD) ingested into this wiki. Each page documents the metadata, SHA-256 hash, page count, and ingestion warnings for its respective PDF. These records serve as the foundational traceability layer, ensuring that every extracted claim, entity, and relationship can be reliably linked back to the exact pages of the original source documents.

## Pages

- [[danibd-2023|Source: DANIBD_2023.pdf]] — Provenance record for the 29-page 2023 annual report, including file hash and extraction warnings.
- [[danibd-2024|Source: DANIBD_2024.pdf]] — Provenance record for the 47-page 2024 annual report, including file hash and extraction warnings.
- [[danibd-2025|Source: DANIBD_2025.pdf]] — Provenance record for the 54-page 2025 annual report, including file hash and extraction warnings.
